record.original_question: Let r and p be integers with p ≥ 2. For symmetric deterministic tensors T1, …, Tn ∈ (R^d)^{⊗ r} and independent standard Gaussian variables g1, …, gn, define the symmetric injective ℓ_p norm by ||T||_{I_p} = max_{||x||_p ≤ 1} |⟨T, x^{⊗ r}⟩|. Is it true that there is a bound of the form E ||∑_{i=1}^n g_i T_i||_{I_p} ≤ Õ_{r,p}( d^{1/2 - 1/p} (∑_{i=1}^n ||T_i||_{I_p}^2)^{1/2} ), where Õ_{r,p} hides constants depending on r and p and polylogarithmic factors in d and n?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 16 (Type-2 constant of Tensors). Let p ≥ 2, then E ||∑_{i=1}^n g_i T_i||_{I_p} ≤ O˜_{r,p}( d^{1/2 - 1/p} √(∑_{i=1}^n ||T_i||_{I_p}^2) ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix integers $r \ge 1$ and $p \ge 2$, and let $d, n \ge 1$. A tensor $T \in (\mathbb{R}^d)^{\otimes r}$ is called symmetric if its entries $T_{i_1 \dots i_r}$ are invariant under all permutations of the indices. For a symmetric tensor $T$ define its symmetric injective $\ell_p$ norm by
$$\|T\|_{I_p} \;=\; \max_{\substack{x \in \mathbb{R}^d \\ \|x\|_p \le 1}} \bigl|\langle T, x^{\otimes r}\rangle\bigr|, \qquad \langle T, x^{\otimes r}\rangle \;=\; \sum_{i_1,\dots,i_r=1}^{d} T_{i_1\dots i_r}\, x_{i_1}\cdots x_{i_r}.$$
Let $T_1, \dots, T_n \in (\mathbb{R}^d)^{\otimes r}$ be deterministic symmetric tensors, and let $g_1, \dots, g_n$ be independent standard Gaussian random variables. Determine whether there exists a constant depending only on $r$ and $p$, together with polylogarithmic factors in $d$ and $n$ (denoted $\widetilde{O}_{r,p}$), such that
$$\mathbb{E}\, \Bigl\| \sum_{i=1}^n g_i\, T_i \Bigr\|_{I_p} \;\le\; \widetilde{O}_{r,p}\!\left( d^{\,1/2 - 1/p}\, \Bigl(\sum_{i=1}^n \|T_i\|_{I_p}^{\,2}\Bigr)^{\!1/2}\right)$$
holds for every choice of $d$, $n$, and symmetric tensors $T_1, \dots, T_n$.
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is posed as a conjecture in a 2025 collection of open problems on Gaussian tensor injective norms (a "type-2 constant" type bound for symmetric tensors). No published resolution was located, so it appears to remain open.
